page.content:
Union that sets Broadway production contracts for actors and stage managers.

How Actors' Equity Association connects

  • Topic: Broadway — Actors' Equity sets the Production Contract that governs Broadway companies.
  • Concept: Equity Production Contract — Actors' Equity bargains the Production Contract used on Broadway.

What is Actors' Equity Association?

Actors' Equity Association is the labor union whose Production Contract governs Broadway performers and stage managers, the rulebook behind every Tony-eligible company.

Key threads lead to Broadway and Equity Production Contract.
